name: Show No Mercy
aliases: Show No Mercy: NYC Slayer Tribute

evidence.note: Oct 3 'Big 4' tribute show at 89 North with Damage Inc and Chaotica, posted by the band.
Venue page bills a night of thrash metal with the band playing Reign in Blood in full.

dancing.notes: A thrash-metal tribute concert: fans headbang and may start a mosh pit, but there is no social or partner dancing.

description: Long-running New York City and Long Island Slayer tribute band; on Oct 3 it plays the yearly 'Big 4' thrash-metal tribute night at 89 North in Patchogue with Damage Inc. and Chaotica.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Confirmed Slayer tribute. Damage Inc. on the same bill is a Metallica tribute.
